name: Venture Co. Engineering Plans
summary: At Windshear Crag, Alliance operatives seek the Venture Co. Engineering Plans inside the goblin mill. The schematics show how the logging machines are built.

sections.title: Industrial Secrets
sections.body: South of Cragpool Lake, inside the lumber mill, the Venture Co. Engineering Plans reveal how the timber machines are built. They show the machines’ strengths and flaws. The Venture Company uses them to strip the forests of Stonetalon, while smoke hangs over Windshear Crag.

sections.title: Gnomish Espionage
sections.body: Gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle directs a covert operation against the Venture Company's logging works and seeks the plans. Explosives can disrupt the mill at once. The schematics also let Alliance craftspeople exploit weaknesses in goblin equipment and adapt its designs for Alliance projects.

faq.q: Where are the Venture Co. Engineering Plans located?
faq.answer: The Venture Co. Engineering Plans are inside the Venture Company's primary lumber mill at Windshear Crag, south of Cragpool Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Gaxim Rustfizzle, an Alliance gnome coordinating covert actions in the Stonetalon Mountains, sends agents to recover the plans.

faq.q: Why are these blueprints important to the Alliance?
faq.answer: The schematics reveal flaws in the Venture Company's logging machinery, helping operatives dismantle it. They also give Alliance gnomes industrial designs to adapt for their inventions.

faq.q: What operation is tied to stealing these plans?
faq.answer: Recovering the plans is the chief aim of Covert Ops - Alpha. Agents also plant detonators throughout the site, and returning with the blueprints marks the operation's success.

angles.text: As a gnome tinkerer, capturing rival goblin schematics offers an intellectual victory and industrial ideas to adapt.
As an engineer, you can study the Venture Company's brutal, resource-hungry machines for insights into heavy industrial machinery.
